messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: gateway-503-surge — elevated 5xx in api-gateway/us-west-2. Threshold breached 03:21 UTC. @Sam (oncall) paging now. Impact: ~12% error rate for /v1/generate, increasing latency. Please acknowledge and triage.
Sam (oncall): acked. I'm looking. Any customer-facing alerts? Maya, do we have customer reports?
Maya: we've got 3 support threads mentioning timeouts / 502/503 from prod. One enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) reporting failed requests. See support ticket #SUP-1212.
Sam (oncall): thanks. Initial check: gateway pods show surge in 5xx across multiple AZs. Could be backend timeout or routing. Jules, can you pull ingress logs and trace for a request id? We might be missing traces for some paths.
Jules: pulling logs now. Not seeing X-Request-ID in a bunch of logs from the routing layer — looks like header is getting stripped in our edge LB for requests that hit the new NGX pool. Suspect missing propagation.
Li: for context, we rolled edge config at 02:55 UTC to add rate-limit changes + header sanitization. Could be a regression. I can roll back the change, but want to confirm cause first.
Sam (oncall): try routing a small fraction to previous config (canary rollback). Also increase logging on the edge to get more traces. We need stopgap instrumentation: temporarily inject X-Request-ID if missing and log it at gateway.
Natalie: I can hotpatch the gateway to attach synthetic request-id for any incoming headerless requests. Prep snippet: 
Natalie: ```nginx
if ($http_x_request_id = '') {
  set $http_x_request_id $request_id;
}
add_header X-Request-ID $http_x_request_id;
```
Sam (oncall): nice. Deploy that to a subset of pods in us-west-2 (20%) and monitor 5xx rate.
deploy-bot: Started canary deploy: gateway/edge-config-hotpatch -> 20% in us-west-2. Rollout id r-2026-3087654321
Jules: logs after canary show a drop in 5xx from the patched pods: patched pods 3.4% errors vs unpatched 12.1%. Looks promising.
Maya: customer impact note: AcmeCorp seeing ~30% of their requests fail. Support notified. We should prepare an incident SEV2 customer comms draft.
Sam (oncall): agree. Also we still have missing spans for some requests — tracer didn't attach for many requests prior to hotpatch. We need temporary trace flagging. ops-bot can we enable debug tracing for a small sample for 10min?
ops-bot: Enabling tracing sample=0.5% for route /v1/generate for 10m in us-west-2. Confirmed.
Jules: grabbed a sample trace from a failing request. The trace stops at edge/nginx — no span forwarded to backend. Payload size is normal. Error code 504 from backend pool when retrying.
Li: confirming the edge change at 02:55 modified proxy_buffering and header sanitation. Looks like a bug where header normalization drops X-Request-ID when upstream has chunked transfer. Reverting that flag on unpatched pods now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for config r-2026-3087654210 on 80% of pods.
Sam (oncall): monitoring. If 5xx falls below 2% across AZs, we'll scale down incident. Also set fallback routing to secondary backend until full rollback completes.
Jules: Fallback routing engaged for 10% of traffic to secondary-backend in us-west-2.
Maya: created a customer comms update: "We're investigating elevated errors affecting some API requests; we've engaged mitigation and will follow up in 30m." Posting to AcmeCorp rep now.
Sam (oncall): good. Quick checklist for postmortem: root cause (edge header sanitization regression), why request IDs were missing (config change), why traces were sparse (missing propagation), mitigation steps (hotpatch to attach synthetic IDs, rollback config, fallback routing), impact (AcmeCorp partial outage, overall 5xx spike ~15min), detection & paging timeline, and action items (add unit test for header propagation, add alert for sudden drop in request_id presence, increase sampling window on edge during deploys).
Natalie: I'll open the follow-up ticket and own the hotpatch-to-prod rollout after rollback verification.
Sam (oncall): thanks team. Keep monitoring for 20m, then we'll join a brief post-incident huddle. I'll update #incidents when we hit steady-state.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback complete on 80% — config restored.
Jules: metrics trending down — total 5xx now 1.6% in us-west-2. Traces show proper X-Request-ID propagation restored for new requests.
Maya: update sent to AcmeCorp: short outage, mitigated, we'll follow with full postmortem in 48h.
Sam (oncall): incident resolved for now. Closing the active pager. Thanks.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT: RESOLVED — gateway-503-surge. Duration 00:34:19. Major customer impacted: AcmeCorp. Postmortem owner: Natalie.
